# thunder_system_domain_list_settings (Resource)

`thunder_system_domain_list_settings`: Configure global domain classification list settings

__PLACEHOLDER__



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `concurrent_task` (Number) Configure max concurrent AXFR task (Default 6)
- `domain_list_per_group` (String) '16': Allow 16 domain-list per group (Default); '32': Allow 32 domain-list per group;
- `polling_interval` (String) '1-second': Set interval to 1 second; '5-second': Set interval to 5 seconds; '10-second': Set interval to 10 seconds (Default);
- `uuid` (String) uuid of the object

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
